Calculate Integration Normalized Mutual Information (NMI)

Source: R/07_multiomics_coupling.R
calc_integration_nmi.Rd

Computes Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) between clusters in the integrated multiomics space and ground-truth cell-type labels, following scib, scCross, scMultiSim, Matilda, and scMoMtF.

Usage

calc_integration_nmi(embed, cell_type, n_clusters = NULL)

Arguments

embed

Numeric matrix of cell coordinates (cells x dimensions).

cell_type

Vector or factor of ground-truth cell-type labels.

n_clusters

Number of clusters (defaults to the number of unique cell types).

Value

Numeric scalar between 0 and 1, where 1 indicates perfect mutual information.

References

Luecken et al. (2022) Benchmarking atlas-level data integration. Nature Methods. Ding et al. (2023) scCross. Li et al. (2023) scMultiSim. Cell Systems. Yang et al. (2023) Matilda. Nucleic Acids Research. Lan et al. (2024) scMoMtF.

Examples

set.seed(42)
emb <- matrix(rnorm(60 * 4), 60, 4)
ct <- rep(c("TypeA", "TypeB"), each = 30)
calc_integration_nmi(emb, ct)
#> [1] 0.01220327
